message:
1 positional locator read(s) taken in the window an action opened, with no auto-retrying assertion between:
      card.spec.ts:14 — reads a positional locator written into the read itself in the window the action at line 13 opened: expect(await colourOf(page.locator(' ').first(), ' ')).toBe( ' ', )
    A
why: The hovered card's race, read through `const colourOf = styleOf;`. The second name is the first helper under another word, and unread it is a call of no kind, so the race goes by unreported. Read as a call of `styleOf`, it is a reader, as `styleOf` is.
